approval_required_for: Any change to numeric precision, quantization intent, or numeric-policy values.
Adding, replacing, or materially modifying a template or its supported-use metadata.
Any major change to design-space architecture, parameter bindings, or resource assumptions.

executable_actions.on_failure: Record each check as failed or not_run with its artifact and constraint evidence, retain the identified binding gaps, and do not claim the input contract passes. Do not alter numeric policy, create or claim templates, or change design-space assumptions; route proposed material changes for the required approval and hand off the evidence to the cross-layer readiness auditor and SACG extraction.
executable_actions.rationale: Evaluate the full numeric policy, template library and metadata, and design space using the registered checks so claims and bindings are traceable to the named SACG constraints. The compact summary does not expose enough detail to report a pass or identify specific missing fields.

observations: The artifact inventory includes all four requested input classes. Their presence alone does not establish field validity, traceability, coverage, or consistency.

The candidate summary exposes only partial key names and counts, not the numeric-policy values, template identities and metadata, or design-space parameter/resource assumptions needed for this review.
No results from numeric_policy_check, template_coverage_check, parameter_binding_static_check, or template_binding_static_check are supplied; no pass is claimed.
The prepared_inputs summary reports one error entry but omits its detail, so its relevance to these inputs cannot be determined from the supplied evidence.
sacg_memory_truth reports zero active contamination barriers and zero open retry or backtrack requests.
proposed_actions: Run all four registered static checks on the full supplied artifacts and record checker-grounded findings in the numeric/template audit and template-binding gaps outputs.

For any failed or not-run check, identify the exact artifact field and constraint involved; route any proposed numeric-policy, template-library, or major design-space change for approval rather than making it in this review.
risks: Numeric precision and quantization intent, and any required numeric-policy fields, remain unverified until numeric_policy_check evaluates the full policy against its registered requirements.
Template support and metadata coverage for the intended design inputs remain unverified; unsupported template claims must not be treated as available implementations.
Parameter bindings and resource assumptions in design_space may be missing, ambiguous, or inconsistent with the selected templates; their values are not visible in the supplied summary.
Cross-layer consistency with model configuration, tensor shapes, data order, memory, runtime, implementation, and board constraints cannot be established from this artifact summary.
The unexplained prepared_inputs error may affect input readiness; inspect its full detail during the static review without assuming it is a numeric or template defect.
